findings.title: "execute" is a generic name
findings.detail: With several servers connected, generic names collide or get shadowed by another server's tool.
findings.fix: Prefix tool names with the server or domain, e.g. "acme_search".

findings.title: 2 of 2 tools have no human-readable title
findings.detail: Since 2025-06-18 clients show the title in approval prompts. Missing: execute, search_docs

findings.title: tools/list works without credentials
findings.detail: Fine for public read-only servers; otherwise require OAuth 2.1 / bearer auth.
findings.fix: Return 401 with WWW-Authenticate for protected servers.

findings.title: CORS allows any origin (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *)
findings.detail: Any website the user visits can script calls to this server from the browser.

findings.title: Requests with a foreign Origin header are accepted
findings.detail: The MCP Streamable HTTP spec says servers MUST validate Origin to prevent DNS-rebinding attacks, which matters most for localhost servers.
findings.fix: Reject requests whose Origin is not on an allow-list (403).
